newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLL- POHJOLA JAN-JUNE SEEN RISING.
newsitem.headline: POLL- POHJOLA JAN-JUNE SEEN RISING.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 507.5 million markka median
forecast for insurer Pohjola Oy's first-half operating profit.
Operating profit
(FIM million)
Median 507.5
Mean 519.2
Lowest 410.0
Highest 625.0
The results are due on August 21 at 0930/0630 GMT.
In 1996, Pohjola's January-June operating profit was 466
million markka.
In March, Pohjola said it expected higher premium income in
1997, but the balance on the technical account would not change
markedly from 1996.
Five analysts polled gave forecasts for full-year 1997 and
the median was for a 750 million markka operating profit (mean
751). Estimates ranged in widely from 510 to 1,025 million
markka, and analysts said it was difficult to estimate how the
insurer would book securities gains.
In 1996 Pohjola's full-year operating profit was 526 million
markka.
Contributing to the survey were Aros Securities, Alfred
Berg, Carnegie, Evli Securities, Handelsbanken and Merita.
